currentWork.title: FINAL.60 live: external navigation only (in-app truck route planning retired)
currentWork.scope: Owner directed removal of in-app routing and navigation. The UI and loaded runtime no longer offer HGV internal route, truck vehicle editor, highway preference switch, route calculation, reroute, route overlay, turn guidance or diagnostics; no client request to /api/route, and truck-routing.js is not loaded. Registered vending machines, deliveries and offices open Google Maps destination externally using saved coordinates or address; map pins, filters, current location arrow, map position picker and fullscreen remain. External navigation does NOT inherit registered 2t truck height/width/weight restrictions, so a visible map notice explains this. Existing saved routeVehicle data retained but dormant; backend route endpoint and archived tests retained in source for safe rollback, not in active product.
